title: Tide and Garden
author: Mara Fairweather
blurb: Edmund Coldharbour, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
